statusMeaning.implemented: Behaviour ported and reachable in the UI; covered by tests, but not every upstream test case has a ported equivalent.
statusMeaning.verified: Additionally, the upstream test cases of the area have ported equivalents that pass (unit and/or browser e2e).
statusMeaning.in_progress: Implemented, but a required target (e.g. performance) is not met yet.

deviations: Browsers reserve ⌘N/⌘W: ⌥⌘N/⌥⌘W in a browser, ⌘N/⌘W as aliases where a host passes them on.
Page close offers only the browser's generic prompt; per-tab Save/Don't Save happens when closing a tab. IndexedDB recovery copies cover reloads and crashes.
Non-separable blend modes stacked on each other can differ by isolated large values between GPU and CPU where SetSat is discontinuous (statistical bound in gpu-vs-cpu).
WebGL 2 is required; there is no software-rendering fallback (upstream: CoreGraphics fallback).
Layer textures are sparse chunks with 64 px aprons instead of TiledLayerRenderer pieces; readback is full resolution beyond MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE.
Core Image perspective sampling is replaced by inverse homography with premultiplied bilinear sampling.
The system clipboard is read through the paste event or the async Clipboard API; after a denied permission only the internal clipboard is available.
Large soft brushes use a two-pixel quadratic density reconstruction (≤1/255 against the reference implementation).

During a stroke, paint/erase on layers and masks is previewed by GPU coverage (MetalBrushCoverage port, ≤2/255 against the exact CPU result); the exact raster is computed incrementally in a Web Worker and committed about 0.25 s after pointer-up as one undo step. Clone Stamp, Spot Healing, Smudge/Blur and selection-limited strokes keep the synchronous CPU preview.
Core Image Gaussian and axis-aligned motion blur use three sliding box passes; oblique motion blur uses sampled Gaussian convolution.
Blur previews keep the original layer grid; Apply uses the expanded bounds as upstream.
Apple Vision is replaced by the local U²-Netp model (Apache-2.0) on ONNX Runtime Web; it yields one fused salient map, not separate subject instances.
The browser test needs a reference photo outside the repository and is skipped when it is absent.
HEIC is decoded only by browsers that support it; elsewhere a readable error asks for JPEG/PNG.
Default project format is the host contract's ZIP archive; the macOS .comp package (versions 1–7) is read (zipped or as a folder) and written as a copy.
Save overwrites a chosen file only where the File System Access API exists (Chromium); other browsers download.
No ICC colour conversion: documents are sRGB.
